selection_rule.note: Target is fixed independently of model performance. See revision_history.

revision_history.previous_description: Filter eligible subclasses (>= 50 TEST instances), sort alphabetically, select the first.
revision_history.rationale: Backdoor is a minority attack family with sufficient test support and distinct properties from larger attack families (Generic, Exploits, DoS). Fixing the target by name before any training/evaluation preserves pre-registration integrity while ensuring the chosen class is theoretically interesting for the unseen-attack hypothesis.
revision_history.disclosure: The candidate count data (including Backdoor's count of 583 test instances) was available when the fixed_named_target rule was formulated. The integrity claim is that this revision occurred before any model training, model evaluation, or performance-based analysis — not that the counts were unseen. The choice of Backdoor was based on methodological rationale (minority class, distinct attack family) and not on model performance metrics.
